name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: Resolution on continued financial and military support to Ukraine by EU Member States
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is setting out its opinion and asking EU countries to keep giving Ukraine money, weapons and humanitarian aid, and to stop buying Russian fuel. It asks countries to lift limits on how Ukraine uses Western weapons, to send more air defence and ammunition, and to use frozen Russian assets to pay for Ukraine's defence and rebuilding.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks EU governments to act; they decide.
- **Who it affects:** Ukraine, EU taxpayers, and countries buying Russian fuel.
- **What happens next:** EU governments and the Commission decide whether to follow these requests.
